probes.label: Start Here — decision contract
probes.sourcePage: Start Here — How to use the Probes
probes.question: Which decision is being made now, which evidence can change it, and what conditions support a responsible abstention or two-spike comparison?
probes.whatItReveals: Whether the team has a bounded decision, a declared horizon, and a route for uncertainty.
probes.technicalCore: Decision scope, candidate-set contract, probability-of-what, evidence classes, review horizon, and exit criteria.
probes.edgeCasesAndComplexity: Different teams may need separate decisions; a styling decision and rendering-framework decision can have different horizons.
probes.aiCollaborationDirective: Ask for the decision object, candidate-set semantics, horizon, constraints, and abstention conditions before ranking technologies.
probes.abstentionCondition: The outcome or candidate set remains materially undefined.

probes.label: HTML — semantic ownership
probes.question: Which interaction semantics belong to native HTML, and which candidate stack preserves those semantics through component abstraction and server or client rendering?
probes.whatItReveals: Whether a stack amplifies or obscures semantic structure, form behavior, naming, focus, and progressive enhancement.
probes.technicalCore: Native elements, form association, accessible naming, DOM order, hydration boundaries, custom elements, and server-rendered markup.
probes.edgeCasesAndComplexity: Portals, shadow DOM, nested interactive controls, streaming markup, and abstraction layers can change ownership of semantics.
probes.aiCollaborationDirective: Generate the native semantic baseline first, then show exactly which abstraction layer changes it and how local verification will confirm equivalence.
probes.abstentionCondition: The interaction purpose and semantic baseline remain unclear.

probes.label: CSS — cascade and replacement path
probes.question: How does each styling option distribute cascade, tokens, component boundaries, and override authority, and what would replacing that layer cost after six months?
probes.whatItReveals: Whether short-term generation speed produces readable, governable, and swappable styling.
probes.technicalCore: Cascade layers, specificity, scoping, design tokens, container queries, utility composition, generated classes, and dead-style removal.
probes.edgeCasesAndComplexity: Third-party component styles, shadow DOM, CSS-in-JS ordering, SSR extraction, theme overrides, and utility-class density.
probes.aiCollaborationDirective: Describe the cascade and ownership model, show one replacement seam, and estimate migration work by artifact rather than by optimistic line count.
probes.abstentionCondition: The visual system and override authority remain undeclared.

probes.label: SVG — coordinate, transform, and label fit
probes.question: Can the candidate stack preserve SVG coordinate systems, grouping, transforms, label placement, accessible text alternatives, and high-density interaction without framework-specific distortion?
probes.whatItReveals: Whether the stack supports diagram and data-visualization work as a first-class surface.
probes.technicalCore: viewBox, coordinate transforms, nested groups, pointer and keyboard events, accessible naming, text measurement, collision detection, and responsive redraw.
probes.edgeCasesAndComplexity: Zoom/pan, foreignObject, high-DPI rendering, transformed hit targets, label overlap, screen-reader grouping, and large node counts.
probes.aiCollaborationDirective: Keep geometry in a framework-neutral model, use grouped transforms, expose a table equivalent, and test one dense label-placement case.
probes.abstentionCondition: The visualization complexity and label-density envelope remain unknown.

probes.label: JavaScript — effects and resource lifetimes
probes.question: How does each option acquire, retain, cancel, and release listeners, subscriptions, observers, workers, timers, fetches, and shared state under navigation and repeated rendering?
probes.whatItReveals: Whether the framework and application pattern preserve deterministic cleanup and bounded runtime behavior.
probes.technicalCore: AbortController, event-listener identity, subscriptions, observers, timers, worker lifetimes, async races, and idempotent cleanup.
probes.edgeCasesAndComplexity: Strict development replays, interrupted rendering, route transitions, cached components, shared workers, and duplicate commits.
probes.aiCollaborationDirective: For every acquired resource, name the release path, error path, ownership boundary, and repeat-render behavior.
probes.abstentionCondition: The runtime and navigation model remain undefined.

probes.label: React — rendering and version coherence
probes.question: Which rendering, state, external-store, action, and hydration assumptions are version-bound, and what local evidence shows visual coherence under urgent and deferred updates?
probes.whatItReveals: Whether a React candidate depends on current-version behavior that the team has named, tested, and can revisit.
probes.technicalCore: Concurrent rendering, external-store snapshots, transitions, deferred values, server/client boundaries, actions, hydration, and versioned dependency contracts.
probes.edgeCasesAndComplexity: Mixed dependency versions, legacy roots, external stores, streaming, suspense boundaries, third-party component assumptions, and development-only replay behavior.
probes.aiCollaborationDirective: State the exact version assumptions, use current official documentation as the source anchor, and provide a local coherence test before recommending architecture.
probes.abstentionCondition: The exact React and integration versions remain unknown.

probes.label: Pattern–Problem Surface — label placement
probes.sourcePage: Pattern-Problem Surface for Visual Label Placement
probes.question: Which label-placement method fits the geometry, density, motion, priority, and accessibility needs of the intended visualization surface?
probes.whatItReveals: Whether labels need a grid, greedy placement, force model, anchor-point rules, constraint solving, or an optimization pass.
probes.technicalCore: Anchor candidates, bounding boxes, spatial indexes, collision detection, priority, simulated annealing or other optimization, and stable reflow.
probes.edgeCasesAndComplexity: Dense zones, moving points, multilingual labels, variable font metrics, zoom levels, pointer targets, and deterministic export.
probes.aiCollaborationDirective: Describe the geometry and density first; compare at least two placement strategies using the same labeled scene and measurable collision criteria.
probes.abstentionCondition: The geometry, density, and motion envelope remain unspecified.
